messages.text:
"make a JRPG inspired game that has these little things in the pictures I've given to you (actually, only some of them are little).  where the setting is a very large dull-ish beige grass field with buildings you could enter that has the characters working, and you can find Items on the ground of every part of the world you can explore and you can even find money and other items in bushes, holes in the ground (for some reason), and many more places. with the unemployed algebraliens being carefree and layed back using the more attractive character assets given, and the employed, cheerful and happy algebraliens (and 1 stand out algebralien being employed but insanely depressed and somewhat cynical) using the smaller and cuter character assets. cut up the assets that I gave. there will be a no batting involved and will only require talking, which is the talk option, flirt option, and gift option. the aesthetic will be like a summer day in a Japanese city. there will be towns that you can visit everyone (everyone knows everyone in this game) and you can even flirt with someone enough times and even date them and every character will have a different date sequence.

Attachments:

- ![Untitled9_20261101172515.png](https://omgithub.com/api/issue-attachments/ee26fa85-6429-494b-a5e1-f82a1689e464)

- ![Untitled4_20261101170112.png](https://omgithub.com/api/issue-attachments/e29955bb-6ba5-4df2-a8a5-93671fb76682)
"
